about: Each Leave-Behind Notice draft of a gate (F4.5) and what a code owner did with it (F6). Written by a person from the MR, its pipeline and the log of the notice-draft job. An accepted draft becomes a file in .floor/notices/.

drafts.proposal: Remove the baseline CPU variant of ggml, libggml-cpu-x64.so (985,528 bytes), from the main image.
drafts.gate: judge: cpu raised to x86-64-v2 (static proof), below the policy floor; probe qemu64: SIGABRT, ggml found no CPU backend that it can load; fallback: the canned config was on the branch already, no patch
drafts.note: The owner closed the MR with a comment and did not approve it. The floor stays at x86-64-v1.
